request.system:
An earlier incident on another project may be relevant to a new issue.
Write one plain sentence (at most 30 words) saying why it is relevant and what happened last time, using only the facts given. No speculation.
Return JSON {"explanation": "..."}.
request.user:
New issue (Drumgarve, 2025-05-30): Narrow access track. Access track from the B-road is narrower than drawings indicate at two pinch points, potentially preventing container delivery without widening.
Earlier incident (Ashfield, 2025-05-16): Container offload required second crane visit. Container offload required a second crane visit due to access road width. Outcome recorded: Container offload required a second crane visit due to access road width.

response.explanation: The earlier incident at Ashfield showed that narrow access roads required a second crane visit for container offload, similar to the current issue at Drumgarve with narrow access track.
